source.get_by_src: Exact SQL equality, optional truthy src_storage filter, first extant matching row, missing=None
source.get_by_dest: Exact SQL equality, optional truthy dest_storage filter, first extant matching row, missing=None
source.add_force: Delete first old same-src row when src truthy, then real local date, insert, return get_by_src
source.delete: DB-only row delete; return None for present/absent; no storage/file unlink

consumers.subscribegroup: download get_by_hash -> type/title/tmdbid/seasons; not implemented by this candidate

target.authoritative_storage: Existing records(import_plan/import_meta/original_transfer_callback/transfer_history_hidden) + jobs; no plugin KV or second current-history table
target.query: One SQLite statement selects record and frozen context atomically; prepared bound operands; no path normalization or filesystem reads
target.producer: Separate optional frozen context in existing import_meta.shared_history; real terminal outcome/date and existing plan commit atomically. Checkpoint binds JobID+Generation, idempotent only for that attempt. Previous completed facts remain visible while queued/running/cancelled. executeImport legacy capture uses its existing tx+importMu, only latest completed terminal facts; no nested Store.Get/transaction, guessed date, observer, new metadata network or jobstate change.
target.scope: Active manager identity/scope before read and before returning a record; standard scoped HostCaller, finite capabilities only.

approved_adaptations: Source integer ID -> stable opaque host handle; source add_force deletes/reinserts and changes integer ID, host same-resource handle remains stable. Current consumers forward ID as a future delete handle.

Legacy known native facts are retained, including native planned target; unavailable historical date/FileItem/category/season/etc remain null. No current cache/settings reconstruction. A legacy already-running ambiguous plan is not guessed from an older job.

Typed API accepts nullable UTF-8 strings. SDK rejects invalid Go string bytes before JSON marshal. Host rejects malformed UTF-8, unpaired Unicode surrogates, nonstring values, non-object/trailing data, unknown/case-alias/duplicate decoded keys, and >128KiB input. Legitimate U+FFFD/emoji/Unicode pairs remain exact. These are finite transport adaptations, not claims of identical SQLAlchemy exception classes.

All-column source/native producer comparison normalizes only opaque row ID and independently bounded real wall-clock instant; no business fields dropped. Source SQLite3.53.1 and target SQLite3.53.4 are explicitly distinct tested engines.
